en_title: YouTuber Discovers Wild GTA 6 Easter Egg, Cracks Code in Just 3 Days to Reveal Brilliant Surprise
cn_title: 油管主发现《GTA 6》惊人彩蛋，仅用3天破解谜题，揭晓精彩惊喜
opus_summary: 油管主Memeio追踪《GTA 6》地图上的电线，找到12座变电站并破解墙上的字母，按照《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》的秘籍顺序操作开关后，开启了通往过去的传送门，还解锁了Tommy Vercetti的花衬衫和Malibu摩托车。

paragraphs.en: A YouTuber has uncovered the wildest GTA 6 Easter egg yet. Following a series of arcane clues and pulling a set of switches in the correct order sees players transported back to the 1980s.
paragraphs.cn: 一名油管主发现了迄今为止最惊人的《GTA 6》彩蛋。玩家循着一系列晦涩的线索，以正确顺序拉动一组开关后，就会被传送回20世纪80年代。

paragraphs.en: The Easter egg begins in the R&D tower in Key Lento, GTA 6’s starting area, but spans almost the entire map. Players have to pull a series of switches and press certain buttons to trigger a portal into the past, complete with new voice acting from Danny Dyer as Kent Paul.
paragraphs.cn: 这个彩蛋始于《GTA 6》初始区域Key Lento的研发塔，但几乎遍及整张地图。玩家必须拉动一系列开关并按下特定按钮，才能触发一扇通往过去的传送门，其中还有丹尼·戴尔为Kent Paul录制的全新配音。

paragraphs.en: After scaling the tower, the YouTuber ( Memeio ) noticed that a sound effect from GTA Vice City plays when he messed with the lever and button. A poster for LPL (Leonida Power and Light) in the room then guided him around Leonida to the LPL power substations dotted around the map.
paragraphs.cn: 爬上塔后，油管主Memeio注意到，他摆弄拉杆和按钮时会播放一段来自《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》的音效。随后，房间里一张LPL（Leonida Power and Light）的海报指引他走遍Leonida，寻找散布在地图各处的LPL变电站。

paragraphs.en: Each substation contained letters written on its walls. Memeio was so committed to figuring out the mystery that he actually followed the power cables across the map to track them all down.
paragraphs.cn: 每座变电站的墙上都写有字母。Memeio决心解开这个谜团，竟然沿着地图上的电缆找到了所有变电站。

paragraphs.en: After putting all the letters together from all 12 substations, Memeio realized they spelled out an interesting phrase: “Life is passing me by.” That phrase was a cheat code in Vice City that sped up the in-game clock.
paragraphs.cn: 将12座变电站里的所有字母拼在一起后，Memeio发现它们组成了一句有趣的话：「Life is passing me by.」这句话是《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》中的一条秘籍，可以加快游戏内的时钟。

paragraphs.en: On PlayStation, the code for that cheat was: Circle, L1, Square, L1, Square, L1, Triangle, Circle, Triangle.
paragraphs.cn: 在PlayStation上，这条秘籍的按键顺序是：圆圈、L1、方块、L1、方块、L1、三角、圆圈、三角。

paragraphs.en: Memeio realized that he had to enter that code using all the buttons and switches at the various substations, applying a button to different lever flips and button presses. After pressing the buttons in order, without fast travelling, Memeio got an in-game text to head to Reactor 2 between 7pm and 6am. When he did, a portal opened.
paragraphs.cn: Memeio意识到，他必须使用各座变电站里的按钮和开关输入这条秘籍，将每个按键对应到不同的拉杆操作和按钮上。在没有使用快速旅行、按顺序操作按钮后，Memeio收到了一条游戏内短信，要求他在晚上7点至早上6点之间前往2号反应堆。他照做后，一扇传送门打开了。

paragraphs.en: Stepping through the portal transported him to Vice City’s Malibu Club, complete with polygonal graphics. Upstairs, he even saw Kent Paul, voiced by British actor Danny Dyer, reprising his role. Danny Dyer is included in the credits for GTA 6 under the “local population" category.
paragraphs.cn: 穿过传送门后，他被传送到了《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》中的Malibu Club，画面也呈现出多边形图形风格。在楼上，他甚至看到了由英国演员丹尼·戴尔再次配音的Kent Paul。丹尼·戴尔的名字出现在《GTA 6》制作人员名单的「当地居民」类别下。

paragraphs.en: For all that effort, you get access to Tommy Vercetti’s iconic floral shirt and his classic Malibu bike, complete with star decals.
paragraphs.cn: 付出这一番努力后，你可以获得Tommy Vercetti标志性的花衬衫和他那辆经典的Malibu摩托车，车上还有星形贴花。

paragraphs.en: As requested, here is the entire cutscene! I highly recommend you go and do this secret yourself, but I'm happy to share it with the world (I literally spent three days following powerlines in game to find the substations...) 🤓 https://t.co/3NuYYRqlCp
paragraphs.cn: 应大家要求，这是完整的过场动画！我强烈建议你亲自去完成这个秘密，不过我也很乐意与全世界分享（我真的花了三天时间在游戏里沿着电线寻找变电站……）🤓 https://t.co/3NuYYRqlCp

If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者查看第1章指南与提示、第2章指南与提示以及第3章指南与提示，了解前几章的所有细节。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现的内容和可以做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
